verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a real first-party bulk mechanism: the v2 Product Catalog Import API accepts CSV feeds up to 4 GB in upsert or replace mode, reports completion through webhooks, and returns a per-row error CSV. Two narrower bulk behaviors are also documented: report runs that produce downloadable CSVs, and token billing that can apply updated prices to all customers automatically. However, these are confined to specific products (catalog imports are also region-limited) rather than a general bulk-operation facility. missing for 10: general-purpose batch create/update/delete across core resources (customers, subscriptions, refunds, invoices), bulk actions exposed through the MCP/CLI agent tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
